summary: Dry-run previews show the full endpoint path with every non-route segment redacted to :id, so subresources like /metrics or /publish stay visible.
reason: The shared endpoint classifier keeps only two path segments for rate-limit budgets, so dry runs of subresource calls looked like plain collection calls (GET /v1/campaigns for campaign metrics). The literal-segment allowlist fails closed so IDs, emails, and event names never print.
validated_outcome: campaigns metrics get <id> --dry-run reports GET /v1/campaigns/:id/metrics; a test fails if any pp:path route word is missing from the allowlist.
